documents.whyWorthwhile: Autostadt in Wolfsburg, Germany, offers a broader automotive visit through its combination of technology experiences and distinctive architecture.

audience.notes: The experience is particularly suited to children aged seven and above, teenagers and adults. Suitability for younger children is less certain; individual activities may have stricter rules.

documents.name: Bruchhauser Steine circuit
documents.summary: The Bruchhauser Steine loop near Bruchhausen in Germany’s Sauerland region visits the foot of enormous volcanic rock formations on a long forest circuit.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The Bruchhauser Steine loop in Germany’s Sauerland region is worth choosing for close views of huge volcanic rock formations, with a longer forest walk around them.

documents.name: Gangolfsberg basalt circuit from Oberelsbach
documents.summary: The Gangolfsberg loop from Oberelsbach in Germany’s Rhön region visits old beech forest and a striking wall of basalt columns.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The Gangolfsberg loop near Oberelsbach in Germany’s Rhön region brings unusual basalt columns together with old beech forest, especially rewarding in spring woodland bloom or autumn colour.

variants.name: Oberelsbach, Elstal, Gangolfsberg basalt and Dünsberg loop

documents.name: HO7 Hohenstein route
documents.summary: The Hohenstein loop near Hessisch Oldendorf in Germany visits a roughly fifty-metre limestone cliff band above a wooded valley.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The Hohenstein loop near Hessisch Oldendorf in Germany is a worthwhile regional walk for its unexpectedly large limestone cliffs and wooded setting.

documents.name: Rulantica
documents.summary: Rulantica in Rust, Germany, is a large indoor and outdoor water park with varied slides and a coherent themed setting.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Rulantica in Rust, Germany, is worth choosing for its range of slides and the themed setting that connects the indoor and outdoor park.

audience.notes: The strongest fit is children aged five and above, teenagers and adults, with some appeal for preschool children. Suitability for infants and toddlers is less certain. Slides and activities may have stricter rules.

documents.name: Schlaubetal-Wanderweg: Müllrose–Wirchensee
documents.summary: Schlaubetal-Wanderweg in Germany’s eastern Brandenburg region follows lakes, stream valleys, wetlands and historic mill sites from Müllrose to Wirchensee.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The Schlaubetal walk from Müllrose to Wirchensee in Germany offers a varied lowland journey through stream corridors, lakes, wetlands and historic mill landscapes.

documents.name: Tropical Islands
documents.summary: Tropical Islands in Krausnick, Germany, is a tropical bathing and recreation complex inside an enormous former airship hangar.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Tropical Islands in Krausnick, Germany, offers an unusual bathing experience because its tropical recreation world fills a former airship hangar.

audience.notes: The experience has strong appeal from preschool age through adulthood, with some appeal for toddlers. Suitability for infants is less certain. Individual activities may have stricter rules.
